name: White Bean-Quinoa Salad with Citrus, Bell Pepper, Avocado & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 yellow bell peppers
3 oranges
3 grapefruits
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a medium saucepan (set lemons aside for later use).

Add quinoa and broth to the saucepan with the zest, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Juice the lemons into a large bowl, then add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.

Cut off skin and white pith from the oranges and grapefruits. Slice between the membranes to release segments; cut into bite-sized pieces and add both to the bowl, along with the beans. Stir to combine and set aside.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; scoop the flesh out with a spoon and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing and citrus fruit.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide spinach between plates and top with salad. Enjoy!
